test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A place where money is coined
solution: The correct answer is '**Mint**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Mint**'. • It means 'a place where money is coined, especially under state authority. (सिक्‍के ढालना और नोट छापना)' • *Example: freshly **minted** coins...* **Correct Answer:__** *Mint.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Store**: a large shop. (स्‍टोर, बड़ी दुकान) • **Factory**: a building or group of buildings where goods are made in large quantities by machine. (भवन अथवा भवनों का समूह जहाँ मशीन की सहायता सें बड़ी मात्रा में वस्तुएँ तैयार की जाती है; फ़ैक्‍टरी, कारख़ाना) • **Industry**: the production of goods in factories. (कारख़ानों में माल का उत्‍पादन; उद्योग-धंधे; व्‍यवसाय) 3e:T64a, The erroneous part is** 'is awarded'.**
